prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency — the right choice depends on your goals, industry, budget and the channels you need (digital, branding, PR, B2B, B2C, etc.). I can help recommend the best fit for you if you tell me a few things.

Quick questions to narrow it down
- What city/area in Maryland do you prefer (Baltimore, Annapolis, Silver Spring, statewide, remote)?  
- What kinds of marketing do you need (SEO, paid ads, social media, content, email, branding, PR, lead gen, full-service)?  
- Industry or audience (B2B, healthcare, fintech, e‑commerce, local services, nonprofits)?  
- Monthly budget range or annual spend?  
- Timeline (ongoing retainer, campaign, one-off project)?

If you want to research agencies yourself
- Check directories and reviews on Clutch, UpCity and G2 for firm rankings and client reviews.  
- Look for local awards/coverage in Baltimore Business Journal or Maryland Chamber publications.  
- Ask for case studies, references, and measurable KPIs (CAC, LTV, conversion rate improvements).  
- Interview 3–5 agencies and compare proposed strategy, reporting cadence, team members and pricing.

What I can do next
- If you give me the answers above, I’ll shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies that match your needs (with specialties, sample clients, and an estimated price range).
